steps.name: linux-adapter-hook
steps.subject: Select a Linux platform adapter with CLICKER_PLATFORM=linux
steps.description:
On Linux the adapter was always macos.py (tests/conftest.py stands in for the modules it imports).
With CLICKER_PLATFORM=linux, platform_adapter imports linux.py instead: this project's adapter for
KDE Plasma on Wayland (AT-SPI, KWin, portal), placed into the tree by the recipe's overlay. The tests
clear CLICKER_PLATFORM so the suite keeps its macOS stand-ins.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Pending [the selection hook could go upstream with a Linux adapter; ours depends on rungic-cua]
dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: the adapter is exercised by the voice agent's computer use, not by an acceptance scenario)
